Este notebook replica en **Larch 6** la primera versión del modelo OD-buffers **enriquecido e interanual** definido en [07_nested_logit_enriched_interannual.qmd](/Users/vicenteonetto/Desktop/FCFM/MDS/Tesis_Local/tesis-project/03_models/07_nested_logit_enriched_interannual.qmd):

- pooled `2024-W17 + 2025-W17`;
- misma especificación alt-specific base de `05_nested_logit_od_buffers.qmd`;
- mismos bloques `TVH`, `TEI`, `TET`, `NTR`;
- nuevos controles:
  - `DUMMY_ANIO_2025`
  - `LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA`
- ambos entrando diferencialmente en `QR_RED` y `QR_OTHER` respecto de `BIP`.

::: {.callout-note}
En **Larch**, el parámetro del nido se expresa como `Mu:QR` con rango `(0, 1]`.
Para compararlo con Biogeme:

`MU_biogeme ~= 1 / Mu:QR_larch`
:::

## 1) Setup

```{python}
#| label: setup

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import polars as pl
from scipy.stats import norm

import larch as lx
from larch import P, X


def resolve_project_root(start: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    current = (start or Path.cwd()).resolve()
    for candidate in [current, *current.parents]:
        if (candidate / "config").exists() and (candidate / "lib").exists():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("No se pudo resolver PROJECT_ROOT desde el notebook actual.")


PROJECT_ROOT = resolve_project_root()
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))


def format_sample_tag(sample_fraction: float | None) -> str:
    if sample_fraction is None:
        return "full"
    pct = int(round(sample_fraction * 100))
    return f"sample{pct}pct"


print("✅ Setup listo")
print("Larch version:", lx.__version__)
```

## 3) Helpers

```{python}
#| label: helpers

def stratified_sample_partition_choice(
    df: pl.DataFrame,
    *,
    fraction: float | None,
    seed: int = 42,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    if fraction is None:
        return df
    if not (0 < fraction <= 1):
        raise ValueError(f"SAMPLE_FRACTION_ESTIMATION debe estar en (0,1], recibido: {fraction}")
    return (
        df.group_by("partition", "choice_nested", maintain_order=True)
        .map_groups(lambda g: g.sample(fraction=fraction, shuffle=True, seed=seed))
        .sort(["partition", "choice_nested"])
    )


LARCH_NUMERIC_COLUMNS = [
    "choice_nested",
    "DUMMY_LAB_PM",
    "DUMMY_LAB_PT",
    "DUMMY_NO_LAB",
    "DUMMY_ANIO_2025",
    "LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA",
    "LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY",
    "LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY",
    "LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT",
    "LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT",
    "TVH_BIP",
    "TVH_QR_RED",
    "TVH_QR_OTHER",
    "TEI_BIP",
    "TEI_QR_RED",
    "TEI_QR_OTHER",
    "TET_BIP",
    "TET_QR_RED",
    "TET_QR_OTHER",
    "NTR_BIP",
    "NTR_QR_RED",
    "NTR_QR_OTHER",
]


def prepare_larch_dataframe(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    remap = {0: 1, 1: 2, 2: 3}
    missing = [c for c in LARCH_NUMERIC_COLUMNS if c not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas para Larch: {missing}")

    out = (
        df.select([pl.col(c) for c in LARCH_NUMERIC_COLUMNS] + [pl.col("partition")])
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("choice_nested").replace(remap).cast(pl.Int16).alias("choice_larch")
        )
        .drop("choice_nested")
    )
    pdf = out.to_pandas()
    for col in pdf.columns:
        if col in {"partition"}:
            continue
        if col == "choice_larch":
            pdf[col] = pdf[col].astype("int32")
        elif pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(pdf[col]):
            pdf[col] = pdf[col].astype("int32")
        elif pd.api.types.is_float_dtype(pdf[col]):
            pdf[col] = pdf[col].astype("float64")
    return pdf


def build_larch_stats_frame(model: lx.Model, n_obs: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    stats_raw = model.estimation_statistics_raw(compute_loglike_null=True)
    stats = {
        "Number of estimated parameters": len(model.pf),
        "Number of free parameters": int((model.pf["holdfast"] == 0).sum()),
        "Sample size": int(n_obs),
    }
    for key, value in stats_raw.items():
        if isinstance(key, tuple):
            label = " | ".join(str(k) for k in key)
        else:
            label = str(key)
        stats[label] = value
    return pd.DataFrame([stats])


def build_larch_params_frame(model: lx.Model) -> pd.DataFrame:
    pf = model.pf.copy().reset_index().rename(columns={"param_name": "Param", "value": "Value"})
    robust_std_err = np.asarray(model.parameters["robust_std_err"].values, dtype=float)
    robust_t = np.where(
        np.isfinite(robust_std_err) & (robust_std_err > 0),
        pf["Value"].to_numpy(dtype=float) / robust_std_err,
        np.nan,
    )
    robust_p = np.where(np.isfinite(robust_t), 2 * norm.sf(np.abs(robust_t)), np.nan)
    lower = pf["minimum"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    upper = pf["maximum"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    value = pf["Value"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    active_lower = np.isfinite(lower) & (np.abs(value - lower) <= 1e-6)
    active_upper = np.isfinite(upper) & (np.abs(value - upper) <= 1e-6)
    pf["Robust std err."] = robust_std_err
    pf["Robust t-stat."] = robust_t
    pf["Robust p-value"] = robust_p
    pf["Active bound"] = active_lower | active_upper
    pf["Biogeme-comparable MU"] = np.where(
        pf["Param"] == "Mu:QR",
        np.where(value != 0, 1.0 / value, np.nan),
        np.nan,
    )
    return pf[
        [
            "Param",
            "Value",
            "Robust std err.",
            "Robust t-stat.",
            "Robust p-value",
            "minimum",
            "maximum",
            "Active bound",
            "Biogeme-comparable MU",
        ]
    ].rename(columns={"minimum": "Lower bound", "maximum": "Upper bound"})


def load_larch_result_csvs(
    *,
    stats_path: Path,
    params_path: Path,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame | None, pd.DataFrame | None]:
    if not (stats_path.exists() and params_path.exists()):
        return None, None
    return pd.read_csv(stats_path), pd.read_csv(params_path)


def build_larch_enriched_model(
    pandas_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    partition: str,
    max_cap: float = 20.0,
    nested: bool = True,
) -> lx.Model:
    alts = {1: "BIP", 2: "QR_RED", 3: "QR_OTHER"}
    ds = lx.Dataset.construct.from_idco(pandas_df.drop(columns=["partition"], errors="ignore"), alts=alts)
    m = lx.Model(ds)
    model_kind = "Nested" if nested else "MNL"
    m.title = f"{model_kind} OD Buffers enriched interannual ({partition})"
    m.compute_engine = "numba"
    m.choice_co_code = "choice_larch"
    m.availability_co_vars = {1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1}

    m.utility_co[1] = (
        P.B_BIP_T_VEH * X.TVH_BIP
        + P.B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI * X.TEI_BIP
        + P.B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB * X.TET_BIP
        + P.B_BIP_N_TRASB * X.NTR_BIP
    )

    m.utility_co[2] = (
        P.ASC_QR_RED
        + P.B_QR_RED_LAB_PM * X.DUMMY_LAB_PM
        + P.B_QR_RED_LAB_PT * X.DUMMY_LAB_PT
        + P.B_QR_RED_NO_LAB * X.DUMMY_NO_LAB
        + P.B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025 * X.DUMMY_ANIO_2025
        + P.B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND * X.LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA
        + P.B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY * X.LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY
        + P.B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY * X.LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY
        + P.B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT * X.LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT
        + P.B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT * X.LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT
        + P.B_QR_RED_T_VEH * X.TVH_QR_RED
        + P.B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI * X.TEI_QR_RED
        + P.B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB * X.TET_QR_RED
        + P.B_QR_RED_N_TRASB * X.NTR_QR_RED
    )

    m.utility_co[3] = (
        P.ASC_QR_OTHER
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM * X.DUMMY_LAB_PM
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT * X.DUMMY_LAB_PT
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB * X.DUMMY_NO_LAB
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025 * X.DUMMY_ANIO_2025
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND * X.LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY * X.LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY * X.LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT * X.LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT * X.LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH * X.TVH_QR_OTHER
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI * X.TEI_QR_OTHER
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB * X.TET_QR_OTHER
        + P.B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB * X.NTR_QR_OTHER
    )

    if nested:
        m.graph.new_node(parameter="Mu:QR", children=[2, 3], name="QR")
        m.ordering = [
            ("ASCs", "ASC_.*"),
            ("Time Dummies", "B_QR_.*_(LAB_PM|LAB_PT|NO_LAB)"),
            ("Interannual", "B_QR_.*_ANIO_2025"),
            ("Demand", "B_QR_.*_LOG_DEMAND"),
            ("Offer", "B_QR_.*_LOG_(BUS_STOP_DENSITY|METRO_STATION_DENSITY|BUS_LINE_COUNT|METRO_LINE_COUNT)"),
            ("LOS", "B_.*_(T_VEH|T_ESPERA_INI|T_ESPERA_TRASB|N_TRASB)"),
            ("LogSums", "Mu:.*"),
        ]
    else:
        m.initialize_graph(alternative_codes=[1, 2, 3], alternative_names=["BIP", "QR_RED", "QR_OTHER"])
        m.ordering = [
            ("ASCs", "ASC_.*"),
            ("Time Dummies", "B_QR_.*_(LAB_PM|LAB_PT|NO_LAB)"),
            ("Interannual", "B_QR_.*_ANIO_2025"),
            ("Demand", "B_QR_.*_LOG_DEMAND"),
            ("Offer", "B_QR_.*_LOG_(BUS_STOP_DENSITY|METRO_STATION_DENSITY|BUS_LINE_COUNT|METRO_LINE_COUNT)"),
            ("LOS", "B_.*_(T_VEH|T_ESPERA_INI|T_ESPERA_TRASB|N_TRASB)"),
        ]

    m.set_cap(max_cap)
    return m


def estimate_larch_enriched(
    pandas_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    partition: str,
    nested: bool,
    max_cap: float = 20.0,
    method: str = "slsqp",
    quiet: bool = False,
) -> tuple[lx.Model, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    m = build_larch_enriched_model(
        pandas_df,
        partition=partition,
        max_cap=max_cap,
        nested=nested,
    )
    m.maximize_loglike(method=method, quiet=quiet)
    m.calculate_parameter_covariance(robust=True)
    stats = build_larch_stats_frame(m, n_obs=len(pandas_df))
    params = build_larch_params_frame(m)
    return m, stats, params
```

## 4) Carga del pooled y muestra de estimación

```{python}
#| label: build-sample

df_trips_pooled = pl.read_parquet(POOLED_PATH)
print("rows pooled:", df_trips_pooled.height)

df_trips_est = stratified_sample_partition_choice(
    df_trips_pooled,
    fraction=SAMPLE_FRACTION_ESTIMATION,
    seed=SEED,
)

display(
    df_trips_est.group_by(["partition", "choice_nested"]).agg(pl.len().alias("rows")).sort(["partition", "choice_nested"])
)

pdf_larch = prepare_larch_dataframe(df_trips_est)
print("rows estimation:", len(pdf_larch))
```

## 5) Smoke test

```{python}
#| label: smoke-test-larch

smoke_n = min(50_000, len(pdf_larch))
pdf_smoke = pdf_larch.sample(n=smoke_n, random_state=SEED).copy()

model_smoke_nested, stats_smoke_nested, params_smoke_nested = estimate_larch_enriched(
    pdf_smoke,
    partition=f"{MODEL_PARTITION}-SMOKE",
    nested=True,
    method=LARCH_METHOD,
    max_cap=LARCH_MAX_CAP,
)

model_smoke_mnl, stats_smoke_mnl, params_smoke_mnl = estimate_larch_enriched(
    pdf_smoke,
    partition=f"{MODEL_PARTITION}-SMOKE-MNL",
    nested=False,
    method=LARCH_METHOD,
    max_cap=LARCH_MAX_CAP,
)

print("✅ Smoke nested OK")
display(stats_smoke_nested)
display(params_smoke_nested.head(12))

print("✅ Smoke MNL OK")
display(stats_smoke_mnl)
display(params_smoke_mnl.head(12))
```

## 6) Estimación nested principal

```{python}
#| label: estimate-larch-nested

model_larch_nested, stats_larch_nested, params_larch_nested = estimate_larch_enriched(
    pdf_larch,
    partition=MODEL_PARTITION,
    nested=True,
    method=LARCH_METHOD,
    max_cap=LARCH_MAX_CAP,
)

stats_larch_nested.to_csv(LARCH_NESTED_STATS_CSV, index=False)
params_larch_nested.to_csv(LARCH_NESTED_PARAMS_CSV, index=False)

print("✅ Nested guardado en:", OUTPUT_DIR)
print("  -", LARCH_NESTED_STATS_CSV.name)
print("  -", LARCH_NESTED_PARAMS_CSV.name)
display(stats_larch_nested)
display(
    params_larch_nested[
        params_larch_nested["Param"].isin([
            "Mu:QR",
            "ASC_QR_RED",
            "ASC_QR_OTHER",
            "B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025",
            "B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025",
            "B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND",
            "B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND",
        ])
    ]
)
```
